order_wins: **KPI Green Energy** — receives a Work Order from NACOF Oorja for turnkey EPC of a **500 MW / 550 MWp solar project** at its 5,000 MW Bikaner solar park, **Rs 2,025 crore** including taxes _(~28.7% of mcap)_.
**Power Mech Projects** — wins a 60-month O&M contract (October 2026 to September 2031) for Adani group's 2x600 MW Moxie Power plant at Tuticorin, **Rs 549.37 crore** excluding GST _(~7.3% of mcap)_.

**Bondada Engineering** — secures orders across three subsidiaries for BSNL telecom towers in Gujarat, solar plant components in Maharashtra and solar street lighting in Uttar Pradesh, totalling **Rs 146.90 crore** _(~4.8% of mcap)_.
**Valiant Communications** — receives a Letter of Award for communication and grid-protection systems for Indian power utilities, **Rs 40.25 crore** _(~2.4% of mcap)_.
**Jayesh Logistics** — bags a 2-year road-transportation contract from Steel Authority of India (Eastern Region), **Rs 26.88 crore** excluding taxes _(~24.7% of mcap)_.
**Prime Cable Industries** — receives a purchase order from an undisclosed listed Indian company for 11 kV MV cables, **Rs 16.49 crore** including GST, over four months _(~5.0% of mcap)_.
**Canarys Automations** — wins a 12-month AWS/GCP/Azure cloud-services order from Calibo India, **Rs 11.64 crore** _(~6.9% of mcap)_.
**Quest Laboratories** — books **Rs 10.71 crore** of Q3 export orders and Rs 16.90 crore of domestic sales, taking its order book to Rs 39.73 crore _(~7.6% of mcap)_.
**Sugs Lloyd** — receives a Letter of Award from the Golden Temple management (SGPC) for a 2 MW ground-mounted solar project with 10-year maintenance, **Rs 8.90 crore** _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Krystal Integrated Services** — receives a 1-year manpower-services work order from Kosol Energie for its Bavla, Gujarat factory, **Rs 8.75 crore** excluding taxes _(~1.0% of mcap)_.
**ITCONS E-Solutions** — bags a 2-year manpower-outsourcing contract from UP Power Transmission Corporation for 114 resources, **Rs 6.94 crore** _(~2.9% of mcap)_.

**Candour Techtex** — receives an order from Faze 3 Group for 1,85,000 metres of coated and laminated curtain fabric for the US market, about **Rs 4.65 crore**, to be executed by January 2027 _(~2.7% of mcap)_.

**Panache Digilife** — subsidiary Panache Newage Technology wins a 36-month telecom installation, equipment and real-time monitoring work order from an undisclosed domestic telecom customer; value withheld as confidential.
equity_allotments: **Vivo Collaboration Solutions** — allots 22,00,000 new convertible warrants at Rs 77 (**Rs 16.94 crore** in all, 25% received upfront) to promoter UC I T Managed Services, Sanjay Mittal and eight public investors _(~55.7% of mcap)_.
**Containe Technologies** — allots 84,05,000 rights shares (of up to 1,39,88,000 offered), lifting paid-up capital from Rs 6.99 crore to Rs 15.40 crore.
**Sheetal Universal** — receives a further **Rs 5.57 crore** tranche from promoter Hiren Patel against 14,20,000 convertible warrants issued at Rs 210 (past warrants).
**GMR Airports** — allots 10.20 crore shares (0.96% of post-allotment capital) to Aeroports de Paris unit GMR Infra Services on converting 25.5 lakh of its scheme-issued OCRPS (past conversion).
**Nandani Creation** — converts 2,25,000 warrants issued in April 2025 into shares at Rs 44 for promoter Anuj Mundhra (past warrant conversion).
m_and_a: **Ganesh Benzoplast** — signs definitive agreements to sell its JNPT, Goa and Cochin liquid-storage terminals and its Daund rail-logistics unit to KKR-backed Cisternina Logistics for **Rs 1,154 crore**, in tranches over 18-24 months, subject to approvals _(~116.7% of mcap)_.

**Jagsonpal Services** — board approves buying a fintech software platform, brands and IP from promoter-linked Elanistech (nil turnover, negative net worth) for **Rs 10 crore** cash, subject to member approval _(~10.6% of mcap)_.
**ACC** — shareholders, including public shareholders by the required majority, approve ACC's amalgamation into Ambuja Cements at the NCLT-convened meeting.

**JSW Cement** — board approves amalgamating listed subsidiary Shiva Cement into itself, with Shiva's accumulated losses set off against its securities premium, subject to shareholder and NCLT approval.
**TPL Plastech** — board approves its merger into parent Time Technoplast at 403 Time Technoplast shares for every 1,000 TPL shares, appointed date 1 April 2026.
**Sharp Investments** — proposes acquiring 100% of Rajal Lefin & Commercial through a share swap, issuing up to 27.52 crore new shares to non-promoters on a preferential basis.

**Endurance Technologies** — Italian unit Endurance Overseas accelerates buying the remaining 32% of Germany's Stöferle entities for **EUR 18 million** upfront, below the EUR 20.13 million originally agreed, taking it to full ownership.
**Indo Borax & Chemicals** — completes its acquisition of 64.26% (2,38,44,000 shares) of Kronox Lab Sciences from its promoters under the 20 August share purchase agreement.
**Gujarat Energy** — demerged GSPL Transmission receives final listing and trading approval from BSE and NSE for the 31.27 crore shares it allotted to Gujarat Energy shareholders under the scheme.
**Bluspring Enterprises** — approves amalgamating unlisted subsidiary Bluspring New Horizon Two into airline caterer LSG Sky Chefs India, with no cash consideration.
**Cosmo First** — pet-care division Zigly buys Prolife Speciality Vet Clinic in Malad, Mumbai (annual recurring revenue Rs 4.36 crore), its third clinic acquisition; price not disclosed.

**Pidilite Industries** — unit Pidilite Ventures agrees to sell its entire stake in associate Finemake Technologies (FY26 revenue Rs 24.36 crore) back to Finemake's founders at an undisclosed valuation.
**Coal India** — signs a non-binding MoU with Hindustan Urvarak & Rasayan to study a coal-gasification-based urea project at Sindri, Jharkhand, starting with a pre-feasibility report.
**DOMS Industries** — extends the deadline to form its India joint venture with F.I.L.A. group's Seven SpA from 30 September 2026 to 31 January 2027; other terms unchanged.
capex_core: **Rajgor Castor Derivatives** — plans a new derivative-product plant adding 348 MT/day (450 to 798 MT/day) within about 10 months, investing **Rs 61.50 crore** funded by a new Rs 40 crore term loan and accruals _(~71.8% of mcap)_.
**Global Health (Medanta)** — wins a UP Housing Board auction for a 10,560 sq m freehold Ghaziabad land parcel at about **Rs 165.82 crore**, with potential for a 350+ bed hospital _(~0.5% of mcap)_.
**The Ramco Cements** — completes debottlenecking at Jayanthipuram, lifting clinker capacity from 4.61 to 5.62 MTPA and grinding from 3.65 to 4.38 MTPA (company totals 16.95 and 27.17 MTPA).

**Monolithisch India** — announces two silica complexes, Udaipur (175,000 MTPA, Rs 25 crore) and near Hospet (125,000 MTPA, Rs 20 crore), totalling **Rs 45 crore**, with production from July and November 2027 _(~1.7% of mcap)_.

**Sai Silks (Kalamandir)** — redeploys **Rs 20.27 crore** of unutilised IPO proceeds from warehouses to opening new stores within six months, citing delays in warehouse legal diligence _(~1.7% of mcap)_.
**Everest Kanto Cylinder** — subsidiary EKC Egypt completes its Egypt manufacturing facility and starts commercial production.
business_updates: **Results season** — 14 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Arisinfra Solutions** — subsidiary Unitern wins a second Transcon Group mandate, an 18-month developer-as-a-service deal for Transcon UNO in Kalina, Mumbai, a project of ~Rs 400 crore estimated GDV; the fee is not stated.
distress_risk: **Tata Steel** — wins an ITAT order allowing its FY2009 Corus-loan interest deduction, cutting its tax exposure on the issue by **~Rs 427 crore**, from ~Rs 1,686 crore to ~Rs 1,259 crore.

**Fortis Healthcare** — the Supreme Court disposes of IHH's petition against a Delhi High Court order for a forensic audit of IHH's 2018 acquisition of its 31% Fortis stake; IHH says it will cooperate.

**Kalpataru Projects** — Delhi High Court upholds the July order setting aside the termination-payment part of JV Kurukshetra Expressway's arbitral award against NHAI; the JV plans a further challenge.
**United Breweries** — receives income-tax penalty orders across seven assessment years totalling **Rs 54.83 crore**, levied while its appeals on the underlying assessments are pending.
**TVS Srichakra** — receives a GST show-cause notice for FY23 alleging excess input-tax credit, proposing **Rs 17.53 crore** (tax Rs 8.05 crore, interest Rs 7.78 crore, penalty Rs 1.70 crore).

**Nucleus Software Exports** — receives a UP GST show-cause notice for FY23 demanding **Rs 17.49 crore**, including Rs 6.92 crore interest and Rs 0.96 crore penalty, over credit notes and input-tax credit.
**Sanofi India** — receives a Gujarat GST show-cause notice for FY23 over e-way bill and turnover mismatches and ineligible credits, proposing **Rs 16.40 crore** with interest and penalty.

**Artemis Medicare** — receives a CGST show-cause notice for FY23 seeking **Rs 11.11 crore** plus interest and penalty over GST on in-patient medicines; it will join an earlier writ already stayed by the High Court.
**Vikran Engineering** — receives a Rajasthan GST show-cause notice for FY23 over a TDS-turnover mismatch: tax **Rs 4.51 crore**, interest Rs 2.84 crore, penalty Rs 0.45 crore.
**Saurashtra Cement** — receives a Gujarat GST show-cause notice for FY23 of **Rs 3.83 crore** including interest and penalty, which it calls not maintainable.
**Panacea Biotec** — receives two income-tax penalty orders for AY 2022-23 and 2023-24 totalling **~Rs 4.32 crore** for alleged under-reporting; it will appeal.
**Gufic Biosciences** — wins its appeal against a **Rs 4.33 crore** income-tax demand for AY 2024-25, which will be deleted.
**Great Eastern Shipping** — subsidiary Greatship (India) receives eight Maharashtra VAT review notices on charter-hire taxation for 2013-2017; no demand has been computed.
**BGR Energy Systems** — NCLAT adjourns its insolvency appeal to 16 November, noting a settlement proposal with NARCL, and extends the suspension of the NCLT admission order.
**The Hi-Tech Gears** — NCLAT keeps its interim stay on the company's insolvency process and lists the stay-vacation plea for 5 October.
**Naturo Indiabull** — acknowledges a BSE show-cause notice proposing compulsory delisting of its suspended shares and says it will reply within 15 working days.
open_offers: **G-TEC JAINX EDUCATION LIMITED** — G-Tec Education Private Limited open offer for 26.0% (26.49 lakh shares) at Rs 29 vs CMP 36.19 (-19.9%); >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 38 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Indian Acrylics** — Brickwork upgrades its Rs 99 crore bank facilities from **BWR D to BWR BB-/Stable** (long-term) and **BWR D to BWR A4** (short-term) after it repaid a Rs 50 crore term loan.
**ESDS Software Solution** — India Ratings upgrades its bank-loan facilities to **IND A/Stable / IND A1**.
**Samvardhana Motherson** — Japan Credit Rating Agency revises the outlook on its 'A' foreign-currency long-term issuer rating from Stable to **Positive**.
**SIS** — CRISIL reaffirms its Rs 949 crore bank-loan and Rs 250 crore NCD ratings at AA- and revises the outlook from Stable to **Positive**.
other_notable: **STL Networks** — emerges L1 bidder in a RailTel tender for cloud infrastructure at its data centre and DR site, bid value **Rs 249.8 crore** including taxes; no award yet _(~11.4% of mcap)_.

**IRB Infrastructure Developers** — its sponsored IRB InvIT Fund completes a **Rs 2,351 crore** unit raise (Rs 2,000 crore institutional placement, Rs 351 crore preferential) to fund assets bought from IRB's private InvIT.

**Kesoram Industries** — board approves reclassification of its promoter and promoter group under SEBI Regulation 31A and seeks member approval for a new board, with Gautam Agarwalla as Managing Director.
